name: Thandiwe Ndlovu
headline: Junior Backend Developer | Full-Stack Systems | RESTful APIs | Cloud-Native Services | South African Tech Ecosystem
summary: A results-driven junior backend developer with 2 years of hands-on experience in building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. Proven track record in API development, cloud-native services, and performance optimization within South African tech startups. Strong foundation in software engineering principles, with a focus on clean code, system reliability, and measurable outcomes. Active contributor to agile development environments and committed to continuous learning in backend technologies.

Implemented rate limiting and input validation in Express.js to prevent denial-of-service attacks, reducing security incidents by 90% over six months.
Optimized database queries in MongoDB using aggregation pipelines and indexing, improving query performance by 65% and reducing database load by 40% during peak hours.

Authored unit and integration tests using Jest and Mocha, increasing test coverage from 40% to 85% and reducing production bugs by 50%.
Led a team of two junior developers in a sprint to refactor legacy code, improving maintainability and reducing onboarding time for new hires by 30%.
